_comment: P5-T3 DEMO-PROFILE retrieval knobs. Retrieval mechanics (hybrid weights, rrf_k, top_k, reranker) are corpus-independent and are copied from config/retrieval.json deliberately — they are algorithm settings, not measurements. THRESHOLDS ARE NOT COPIED: not_found and routing are derived from THIS corpus's own score distribution (T8's standing rule, restated at the P5-T3 gate). This file starts with both gates OFF for the calibration run that produces the distribution.

not_found._comment: P5-T3 DEMO gate, DERIVED on this corpus — never transferred. Calibration run 20260826T143947 (gate off, all 15 cases scored): worst answerable -0.2844 (dg-005) / best guard -0.3858 (dg-012), margin 0.1014; threshold = midpoint = -0.3351, the same derivation rule the personal corpus's -1.67 came from (-1.27 / -2.07). WATCH: this margin is 0.10 against the personal corpus's 0.80. A single-project documentation corpus is topically homogeneous, so out-of-corpus questions still retrieve semi-relevant chunks and the score distributions compress — a narrow-domain corpus makes the not-found gate HARDER, not easier. REVALIDATE on any reranker or corpus-pin change; treat a margin below 0.05 as a re-derivation trigger.

related_bands._comment: NOT DERIVED for the demo profile — /related is not part of the demo exam. Left at the personal values but UNUSED here; a demo /related calibration is its own task if ever needed.

routing._comment: DISABLED pending demo-derived evidence. The personal band [-1.67, 1.5] was derived from 8 runs of failure clustering on the personal corpus; importing it would be exactly the threshold transfer this ruling forbids.
